text.# Seu Silva — Episódio 1: O pão de sempr:
# Mr. Silva — Episode 1: The usual bread

## Scene 1 — Bakery, 6:40 am
Mr. Silva walks in, greets everyone by name and orders "the usual". The clerk is new and has no idea what that is.

## Scene 2 — The counter
Mr. Silva explains it calmly: toasted bread, a little butter, coffee with a drop of milk in a short glass. The clerk types it all into a tablet. The line grows behind him, and nobody complains, because everyone wants to know how it ends.

## Scene 3 — The table
A pistachio croissant arrives. Mr. Silva tastes it, thinks, and says: "Tomorrow I want this."
